source.document: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, SISTOT, "Relatório Resultado da Totalização", Eleição Geral Federal, 1º Turno, Oficial, Resumo Geral do Brasil; it says its result is subject to change ("sujeito a modificações")
source.transcription: taken from each PDF's own text layer with pdftotext -layout by `actasum br official`, not typed and not read from an image; the command refuses a report whose candidatures do not add up to its valid votes, whose valid, null and blank votes do not add up to its total, or whose null votes in the machines and "nulos técnicos" do not add up to its null votes; from the national summary and the national table of votes per candidate, not from the per-state summaries that follow them
source.stations: item 2.1, sections that functioned: 499176 counted in electronic machines and 31 by the Sistema de Apuração (SA); 41 not installed
source.count_as: the national report has no annex III; the reports of the states and abroad given declare it, and their 5,246 "nulos técnicos" add up to the national figure
